posts.title: Ordinary Nouns
posts.description: I started making t-shirts for some reason and can’t stop. The idea of a shirt that simply says the ordinary nouns with a design evoking what the the intent is instead really got me. It started with just having the words Major City on a shirt being hilarious to me. My first design was the Major City NYC shirt where it all came together and made sense (at least to me).
